integrity: The proof starts from the completed local graded ring explicitly constructed in the source, computes its entire Hilbert function symbolically, extracts the three-dimensional Hilbert--Samuel multiplicity, and uses invariance under completion. The unboundedness step uses the source's strictly increasing integers d_i. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The multiplicity formula is for the specific small-contraction germs in the Li--Li construction. It does not classify their analytic types beyond the completed local-ring description, and it does not assert that unbounded multiplicity occurs in every family of varying-boundary log canonical models.
title: Unbounded Hilbert--Samuel multiplicity among Li--Li log canonical models
